s.note: Sliced bratwurst in a warm curried tomato and paprika sauce with soft rolls
s.how: Cook 1 finely diced onion in 1 tbsp butter for 8 minutes until soft. Stir in 1 tbsp curry powder and 1 tsp sweet paprika for a minute, then add 400ml tomato passata, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp cider vinegar and 0.5 tsp salt and simmer for 15 minutes until thick. Meanwhile fry 6 bratwurst in 1 tbsp vegetable oil for 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Slice thick, pile in a dish, spoon over the sauce and dust with extra curry powder. Serve with toothpicks and 4 soft white rolls.

s.note: Warm gruyère choux puffs with mustard and nutmeg
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C and line 2 trays. Bring 125ml water, 125ml milk, 100g butter and 0.5 tsp salt to the boil. Tip in 150g plain flour all at once and beat over the heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the dough pulls away from the pan. Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time, followed by 1 tsp dijon mustard, a pinch of nutmeg and pepper and 120g grated gruyère. Pipe or spoon walnut-sized mounds onto the trays, top with another 30g gruyère and bake for 25 minutes until puffed, deep golden and crisp. Serve warm.

m.note: Slow-cooked lamb in a deep red Kashmiri chilli, fennel and ginger sauce with yoghurt and basmati rice
m.how: Season 1kg boneless lamb shoulder in 4cm pieces with 1 tsp salt. Heat 3 tbsp ghee, fry 6 cardamom pods, 4 cloves, 1 cinnamon stick and 2 bay leaves for a minute, then brown the lamb in batches. Add 1 finely sliced onion and fry until golden. Stir in 4 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp each of ground ginger and ground fennel, 2 tbsp Kashmiri chilli powder and 1 tsp ground coriander with a splash of water. Stir in 200g whisked Greek yoghurt a spoonful at a time so it doesn't split, add 500ml water, cover and simmer gently for 90 minutes until the lamb is very tender. Cook 300g basmati rice. Stir 0.5 tsp garam masala into the curry, scatter with coriander and serve with the rice.

w.note: Saffron rice pudding, pistachio. Ethan rams one helicopter with another
w.how: Soak 60g basmati rice in water for 30 minutes, drain and blitz to a coarse grit. Warm a pinch of saffron in 2 tbsp of 1 litre full-cream milk. Bring the rest of the milk to a simmer, whisk in the rice and stir on low for 25 minutes until thick like custard. Stir in 100g caster sugar, 0.5 tsp ground cardamom, the saffron milk and 1 tsp rosewater. Pour into 4 small bowls and chill for 2 hours until set. Top with 30g chopped pistachios and a few dried rose petals.

d.note: Gin, lemon and sugar syrup shaken cold and topped with sparkling wine, with a lemon twist
d.how: Stir 40g caster sugar into 40ml hot water until dissolved and cool. Shake 120ml gin with the juice of 2 lemons and the syrup hard with ice. Strain into 4 chilled flutes, top each with sparkling wine from a 500ml pour, and twist a long strip of lemon peel over each before dropping it in.
